rows.title: Last DJ of the Apocalypse (Vol. 1: Sonic Jihad)
notes: “this track is called... album called last dj of the apocalypse by badawi who are an ensemble”
2025 release on UPA Recordings (NY label) by Badawi, the long-running alias of Raz Mesinai; part of a multi-volume 'Last DJ of the Apocalypse' series.
